```{r}
# ============================================================
# GTFS frequency scaling + express overlay generator
# ============================================================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(purrr)
  library(stringr)
  library(lubridate)
  library(digest)
  library(gtfsio)   # import_gtfs(), export_gtfs()
  library(progress)
})

# -----------------------------
# Time helpers (support >24:00:00)
# -----------------------------
time_to_sec <- function(x) {
  if (is.null(x)) return(NULL)
  x <- as.character(x)
  out <- rep(NA_integer_, length(x))
  ok <- !is.na(x) & nzchar(x)
  if (!any(ok)) return(out)

  parts <- str_split_fixed(x[ok], ":", 3)
  h <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(parts[, 1]))
  m <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(parts[, 2]))
  s <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(parts[, 3]))
  out[ok] <- h * 3600L + m * 60L + s
  out
}

sec_to_time <- function(s) {
  s <- as.integer(s)
  h <- s %/% 3600L
  m <- (s %% 3600L) %/% 60L
  sec <- s %% 60L
  sprintf("%d:%02d:%02d", h, m, sec)
}

# -----------------------------
# Collapse feed to two service patterns:
# one representative weekday + one representative weekend/holiday
# -----------------------------

pick_typical_service_date <- function(gtfs, weekday = "wednesday") {
  weekday <- tolower(weekday)

  if (!("calendar" %in% names(gtfs)) || is.null(gtfs$calendar) || nrow(gtfs$calendar) == 0) {
    stop("GTFS has no calendar.txt.")
  }

  cal <- gtfs$calendar %>%
    mutate(
      start_date = ymd(start_date),
      end_date   = ymd(end_date)
    )

  d0 <- min(cal$start_date, na.rm = TRUE)
  d1 <- max(cal$end_date, na.rm = TRUE)

  candidates <- seq.Date(d0, d1, by = "day")
  target_wday <- match(
    weekday,
    tolower(c("sunday","monday","tuesday","wednesday","thursday","friday","saturday"))
  ) - 1L

  candidates <- candidates[(wday(candidates) - 1L) == target_wday]

  if (length(candidates) == 0) stop("No matching weekday dates found in calendar range.")

  # Prefer a date with no exceptions, if possible
  if ("calendar_dates" %in% names(gtfs) && !is.null(gtfs$calendar_dates) && nrow(gtfs$calendar_dates) > 0) {
    cd <- gtfs$calendar_dates %>% mutate(date = ymd(date))

    ex_count <- vapply(candidates, function(d) {
      sum(cd$date == d, na.rm = TRUE)
    }, integer(1))

    if (any(ex_count == 0L)) return(candidates[which(ex_count == 0L)[1]])
    return(candidates[which.min(ex_count)])
  }

  candidates[1]
}

duplicate_trip_block <- function(trips_tbl, stop_times_tbl, trip_ids, new_service_id, trip_suffix) {
  trips_out <- trips_tbl %>%
    filter(trip_id %in% trip_ids) %>%
    mutate(
      trip_id = paste0(as.character(trip_id), trip_suffix),
      service_id = new_service_id
    )

  stop_times_out <- stop_times_tbl %>%
    filter(trip_id %in% trip_ids) %>%
    mutate(
      trip_id = paste0(as.character(trip_id), trip_suffix)
    )

  list(
    trips = trips_out,
    stop_times = stop_times_out
  )
}

collapse_to_two_service_patterns <- function(gtfs,
                                             weekday_date,
                                             weekend_date,
                                             holiday_dates = as.Date(character()),
                                             year = 2026L) {

  weekday_service_id <- paste0("WEEKDAY_", year)
  weekend_service_id <- paste0("WEEKEND_HOLIDAY_", year)

  weekday_source_services <- services_active_on_date(gtfs, weekday_date)
  weekend_source_services <- services_active_on_date(gtfs, weekend_date)

  weekday_trip_ids <- gtfs$trips %>%
    filter(service_id %in% weekday_source_services) %>%
    pull(trip_id) %>%
    unique()

  weekend_trip_ids <- gtfs$trips %>%
    filter(service_id %in% weekend_source_services) %>%
    pull(trip_id) %>%
    unique()

  weekday_block <- duplicate_trip_block(
    trips_tbl = gtfs$trips,
    stop_times_tbl = gtfs$stop_times,
    trip_ids = weekday_trip_ids,
    new_service_id = weekday_service_id,
    trip_suffix = "_WKD"
  )

  weekend_block <- duplicate_trip_block(
    trips_tbl = gtfs$trips,
    stop_times_tbl = gtfs$stop_times,
    trip_ids = weekend_trip_ids,
    new_service_id = weekend_service_id,
    trip_suffix = "_WKE"
  )

  gtfs$trips <- bind_rows(
    weekday_block$trips,
    weekend_block$trips
  )

  gtfs$stop_times <- bind_rows(
    weekday_block$stop_times,
    weekend_block$stop_times
  )

  start_date_chr <- sprintf("%d0101", year)
  end_date_chr   <- sprintf("%d1231", year)

  gtfs$calendar <- tibble::tibble(
    service_id = c(weekday_service_id, weekend_service_id),
    monday    = c(1L, 0L),
    tuesday   = c(1L, 0L),
    wednesday = c(1L, 0L),
    thursday  = c(1L, 0L),
    friday    = c(1L, 0L),
    saturday  = c(0L, 1L),
    sunday    = c(0L, 1L),
    start_date = c(start_date_chr, start_date_chr),
    end_date   = c(end_date_chr, end_date_chr)
  )

  holiday_dates <- sort(unique(as.Date(holiday_dates)))
  holiday_dates <- holiday_dates[!is.na(holiday_dates)]

  if (length(holiday_dates) > 0) {
    gtfs$calendar_dates <- tibble::tibble(
      service_id = c(
        rep(weekday_service_id, length(holiday_dates)),
        rep(weekend_service_id, length(holiday_dates))
      ),
      date = c(
        format(holiday_dates, "%Y%m%d"),
        format(holiday_dates, "%Y%m%d")
      ),
      exception_type = c(
        rep(2L, length(holiday_dates)),  # remove weekday service
        rep(1L, length(holiday_dates))   # add weekend/holiday service
      )
    )
  } else {
    gtfs$calendar_dates <- tibble::tibble(
      service_id = character(),
      date = character(),
      exception_type = integer()
    )
  }

  gtfs
}
# -----------------------------
# Compute services active on a given date (calendar + calendar_dates exceptions)
# -----------------------------
services_active_on_date <- function(gtfs, date) {
  if (!("calendar" %in% names(gtfs)) || is.null(gtfs$calendar)) stop("Missing calendar.txt.")
  cal <- gtfs$calendar %>%
    mutate(
      start_date = ymd(start_date),
      end_date   = ymd(end_date)
    )

  wday_name <- tolower(weekdays(date))  # e.g., "wednesday"
  wday_col <- wday_name
  if (!(wday_col %in% names(cal))) {
    # calendar uses monday..sunday
    stop("Unexpected weekday column naming in calendar.txt.")
  }

  active <- cal %>%
    filter(start_date <= date, end_date >= date, .data[[wday_col]] == 1) %>%
    pull(service_id) %>%
    unique()

  # Apply calendar_dates exceptions if present
  if ("calendar_dates" %in% names(gtfs) && !is.null(gtfs$calendar_dates) && nrow(gtfs$calendar_dates) > 0) {
    cd <- gtfs$calendar_dates %>%
      mutate(date = ymd(date)) %>%
      filter(date == !!date)

    added   <- cd %>% filter(exception_type == 1) %>% pull(service_id) %>% unique()
    removed <- cd %>% filter(exception_type == 2) %>% pull(service_id) %>% unique()

    active <- union(active, added)
    active <- setdiff(active, removed)
  }

  active
}

# -----------------------------
# Expand frequencies.txt into explicit trips (and drop frequencies)
# -----------------------------
expand_frequencies_to_trips <- function(gtfs) {
  if (!("frequencies" %in% names(gtfs)) || is.null(gtfs$frequencies) || nrow(gtfs$frequencies) == 0) {
    return(gtfs)
  }

  freq <- gtfs$frequencies %>%
    mutate(
      start_sec = time_to_sec(start_time),
      end_sec   = time_to_sec(end_time),
      headway_secs = as.integer(headway_secs)
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(start_sec), !is.na(end_sec), !is.na(headway_secs), headway_secs > 0)

  if (nrow(freq) == 0) {
    gtfs$frequencies <- gtfs$frequencies[0, , drop = FALSE]
    return(gtfs)
  }

  st <- gtfs$stop_times %>%
    mutate(
      arr_sec = time_to_sec(arrival_time),
      dep_sec = time_to_sec(departure_time)
    )

  trips <- gtfs$trips

  trip_first_dep <- st %>%
    group_by(trip_id) %>%
    summarize(first_dep_sec = min(dep_sec, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

  # Build explicit runs
  new_trips_list <- list()
  new_stop_times_list <- list()
  kill_trip_ids <- unique(freq$trip_id)

  for (i in seq_len(nrow(freq))) {
    f <- freq[i, ]

    tpl_trip_id <- f$trip_id
    tpl_trip <- trips %>% filter(trip_id == tpl_trip_id)
    tpl_st   <- st %>% filter(trip_id == tpl_trip_id) %>% arrange(stop_sequence)

    if (nrow(tpl_trip) == 0 || nrow(tpl_st) == 0) next

    tpl_first <- trip_first_dep %>% filter(trip_id == tpl_trip_id) %>% pull(first_dep_sec)
    if (length(tpl_first) == 0 || is.na(tpl_first)) next

    # Rebase template so its first departure aligns to frequencies start_time
    rebase_offset <- f$start_sec - tpl_first

    run_starts <- seq(from = f$start_sec, to = f$end_sec - f$headway_secs, by = f$headway_secs)
    if (length(run_starts) == 0) next

    for (k in seq_along(run_starts)) {
      run_start <- run_starts[k]
      shift <- rebase_offset + (run_start - f$start_sec)

      new_trip_id <- paste0(tpl_trip_id, "_FREQ_", sprintf("%04d", i), "_", sprintf("%04d", k))

      nt <- tpl_trip %>%
        mutate(trip_id = new_trip_id)

      nst <- tpl_st %>%
        mutate(
          trip_id = new_trip_id,
          arrival_time   = sec_to_time(arr_sec + shift),
          departure_time = sec_to_time(dep_sec + shift)
        ) %>%
        select(-arr_sec, -dep_sec)

      new_trips_list[[length(new_trips_list) + 1]] <- nt
      new_stop_times_list[[length(new_stop_times_list) + 1]] <- nst
    }
  }

  # Keep non-frequency trips + add expanded trips; drop frequencies table
  trips2 <- trips %>% filter(!trip_id %in% kill_trip_ids) %>% bind_rows(bind_rows(new_trips_list))
  st2    <- gtfs$stop_times %>% filter(!trip_id %in% kill_trip_ids) %>% bind_rows(bind_rows(new_stop_times_list))

  gtfs$trips <- trips2
  gtfs$stop_times <- st2
  gtfs$frequencies <- gtfs$frequencies[0, , drop = FALSE]
  gtfs
}

# -----------------------------
# Add pattern_id per trip based on ordered stop_ids
# -----------------------------
add_pattern_id <- function(gtfs) {
  st <- gtfs$stop_times %>%
    arrange(trip_id, stop_sequence) %>%
    group_by(trip_id) %>%
    summarize(
      pattern_key = paste(stop_id, collapse = "|"),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(pattern_id = vapply(pattern_key, digest, character(1), algo = "xxhash64"))

  gtfs$trips <- gtfs$trips %>% left_join(st %>% select(trip_id, pattern_id), by = "trip_id")
  gtfs
}

# -----------------------------
# Compute trip start time (first departure) per trip
# -----------------------------
compute_trip_starts <- function(gtfs) {
  st <- gtfs$stop_times %>%
    mutate(dep_sec = time_to_sec(departure_time)) %>%
    group_by(trip_id) %>%
    summarize(start_sec = min(dep_sec, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

  gtfs$trips %>%
    left_join(st, by = "trip_id")
}

# -----------------------------
# Headway summary (midday + all-day) by route/direction/pattern
# -----------------------------

# Safe median headway (minutes) given a vector of start times (seconds)
safe_median_headway_min <- function(starts_sec) {
  starts_sec <- sort(starts_sec[is.finite(starts_sec)])
  if (length(starts_sec) < 3) return(NA_real_)
  median(diff(starts_sec)) / 60
}

headway_summary <- function(trips_w_starts, routes_tbl,
                            midday = c("10:00:00", "14:00:00"),
                            allday = c("06:00:00", "19:00:00")) {

  md0 <- time_to_sec(midday[1]); md1 <- time_to_sec(midday[2])
  ad0 <- time_to_sec(allday[1]); ad1 <- time_to_sec(allday[2])

  trips_w_starts %>%
    filter(!is.na(route_id), !is.na(direction_id), !is.na(pattern_id), !is.na(start_sec)) %>%
    group_by(route_id, direction_id, pattern_id) %>%
    summarize(
      trips_midday = sum(start_sec >= md0 & start_sec <= md1, na.rm = TRUE),
      trips_allday = sum(start_sec >= ad0 & start_sec <= ad1, na.rm = TRUE),
      median_headway_midday_min = safe_median_headway_min(start_sec[start_sec >= md0 & start_sec <= md1]),
      median_headway_allday_min = safe_median_headway_min(start_sec[start_sec >= ad0 & start_sec <= ad1]),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    left_join(routes_tbl %>% select(route_id, route_short_name, route_long_name), by = "route_id") %>%
    mutate(
      express_needed = !is.na(median_headway_allday_min) & median_headway_allday_min <= 10,
      multiplier_local = if_else(express_needed, 2L, 3L)
    ) %>%
    arrange(route_short_name, route_id, direction_id, pattern_id)
}

# -----------------------------
# Generate inserted trips between existing trips within a group
# (route_id + direction_id + pattern_id)
# -----------------------------
densify_group <- function(gtfs, group_trips, multiplier, id_prefix = "GEN") {
  # group_trips: trips with start_sec present; already filtered to a single group
  if (multiplier < 2) return(list(trips = gtfs$trips[0, , drop = FALSE],
                                 stop_times = gtfs$stop_times[0, , drop = FALSE]))

  group_trips <- group_trips %>%
    arrange(start_sec)

  if (nrow(group_trips) < 2) {
    return(list(trips = gtfs$trips[0, , drop = FALSE],
                stop_times = gtfs$stop_times[0, , drop = FALSE]))
  }

  st <- gtfs$stop_times %>%
    mutate(arr_sec = time_to_sec(arrival_time),
           dep_sec = time_to_sec(departure_time))

  new_trips <- list()
  new_sts   <- list()
  ctr <- 0L

  for (i in seq_len(nrow(group_trips) - 1)) {
    t0 <- group_trips$start_sec[i]
    t1 <- group_trips$start_sec[i + 1]
    if (is.na(t0) || is.na(t1) || t1 <= t0) next

    dt <- t1 - t0
    tpl_trip_id <- group_trips$trip_id[i]
    tpl_trip <- gtfs$trips %>% filter(trip_id == tpl_trip_id)
    tpl_st   <- st %>% filter(trip_id == tpl_trip_id) %>% arrange(stop_sequence)

    if (nrow(tpl_trip) == 0 || nrow(tpl_st) == 0) next

    for (k in 1:(multiplier - 1)) {
      ctr <- ctr + 1L
      new_start <- t0 + round(dt * (k / multiplier))
      shift <- new_start - t0

      new_trip_id <- paste0(tpl_trip_id, "_", id_prefix, "_", sprintf("%06d", ctr), "_S", shift)

      nt <- tpl_trip %>%
        mutate(trip_id = new_trip_id)

      nst <- tpl_st %>%
        mutate(
          trip_id = new_trip_id,
          arrival_time   = sec_to_time(arr_sec + shift),
          departure_time = sec_to_time(dep_sec + shift)
        ) %>%
        select(-arr_sec, -dep_sec)

      new_trips[[length(new_trips) + 1]] <- nt
      new_sts[[length(new_sts) + 1]]     <- nst
    }
  }

  list(trips = bind_rows(new_trips),
       stop_times = bind_rows(new_sts))
}

# -----------------------------
# Create express overlay for a route_id:
# - new route row
# - express trips cloned from baseline trips (no densification)
# - stop at timepoints only (+ first/last)
# - cumulative -60 sec per skipped stop
# -----------------------------
make_express_overlay <- function(gtfs,
                                 route_id,
                                 express_suffix = "_EXP",
                                 save_per_skipped_stop_sec = 30L,
                                 min_segment_run_sec = 15L,
                                 min_dwell_sec = 0L) {
  if (!("timepoint" %in% names(gtfs$stop_times))) {
    stop("Express overlay requested, but stop_times.txt has no 'timepoint' column.")
  }

  routes <- gtfs$routes
  trips  <- gtfs$trips
  st     <- gtfs$stop_times %>%
    mutate(
      arr_sec = time_to_sec(arrival_time),
      dep_sec = time_to_sec(departure_time)
    )

  base_route <- routes %>% filter(route_id == !!route_id)
  if (nrow(base_route) == 0) stop("route_id not found in routes.txt: ", route_id)

  existing_route_ids <- routes$route_id
  exp_route_id <- paste0(route_id, express_suffix)
  if (exp_route_id %in% existing_route_ids) {
    exp_route_id <- paste0(route_id, "_X")
    if (exp_route_id %in% existing_route_ids) {
      exp_route_id <- paste0(route_id, "_EXP_", substr(digest(route_id), 1, 6))
    }
  }

  exp_route <- base_route %>%
    mutate(
      route_id = exp_route_id,
      route_short_name = if_else(
        !is.na(route_short_name) & nzchar(route_short_name),
        paste0(route_short_name, "X"),
        paste0(route_id, "X")
      ),
      route_long_name = if_else(
        !is.na(route_long_name) & nzchar(route_long_name),
        paste0(route_long_name, " Express"),
        "Express"
      )
    )

  base_trips <- trips %>% filter(route_id == !!route_id)

  new_trips <- list()
  new_sts   <- list()

  for (i in seq_len(nrow(base_trips))) {
    tr <- base_trips[i, ]
    tpl_trip_id <- tr$trip_id

    tpl_st <- st %>%
      filter(trip_id == tpl_trip_id) %>%
      arrange(stop_sequence)

    if (nrow(tpl_st) == 0) next

    # Keep timepoints + endpoints
    keep_idx <- which(tpl_st$timepoint == 1)
    keep_idx <- sort(unique(c(1, keep_idx, nrow(tpl_st))))

    kept <- tpl_st[keep_idx, , drop = FALSE]
    if (nrow(kept) < 2) next

    # Build new times iteratively so every kept-to-kept segment stays valid
    new_arr <- rep(NA_integer_, nrow(kept))
    new_dep <- rep(NA_integer_, nrow(kept))

    # First stop: keep original times
    first_arr <- kept$arr_sec[1]
    first_dep <- kept$dep_sec[1]

    if (is.na(first_arr) && !is.na(first_dep)) first_arr <- first_dep
    if (is.na(first_dep) && !is.na(first_arr)) first_dep <- first_arr
    if (is.na(first_arr) && is.na(first_dep)) next

    if (first_dep < first_arr) first_dep <- first_arr

    new_arr[1] <- first_arr
    new_dep[1] <- first_dep

    # Subsequent kept stops
    for (j in 2:nrow(kept)) {
      prev_idx <- keep_idx[j - 1]
      curr_idx <- keep_idx[j]

      prev_orig_dep <- kept$dep_sec[j - 1]
      curr_orig_arr <- kept$arr_sec[j]
      curr_orig_dep <- kept$dep_sec[j]

      if (is.na(prev_orig_dep) || is.na(curr_orig_arr)) next

      # Original kept-to-kept running time
      orig_run_sec <- curr_orig_arr - prev_orig_dep

      # Guard against odd source data
      if (is.na(orig_run_sec) || orig_run_sec <= 0) {
        orig_run_sec <- min_segment_run_sec
      }

      skipped_between <- curr_idx - prev_idx - 1L
      desired_save_sec <- max(0L, skipped_between) * as.integer(save_per_skipped_stop_sec)

      # Cap savings so resulting run time remains strictly positive and realistic
      max_save_sec <- max(0L, orig_run_sec - as.integer(min_segment_run_sec))
      actual_save_sec <- min(desired_save_sec, max_save_sec)

      new_run_sec <- max(as.integer(min_segment_run_sec), orig_run_sec - actual_save_sec)

      # Preserve original dwell at the kept stop, but never let it go negative
      if (is.na(curr_orig_dep)) curr_orig_dep <- curr_orig_arr
      orig_dwell_sec <- curr_orig_dep - curr_orig_arr
      if (is.na(orig_dwell_sec) || orig_dwell_sec < min_dwell_sec) {
        orig_dwell_sec <- as.integer(min_dwell_sec)
      }

      new_arr[j] <- new_dep[j - 1] + new_run_sec
      new_dep[j] <- new_arr[j] + orig_dwell_sec

      # Final guard: departure cannot be before arrival
      if (new_dep[j] < new_arr[j]) {
        new_dep[j] <- new_arr[j]
      }
    }

    # If any kept stop still failed to get a time, skip this express trip
    if (any(is.na(new_arr)) || any(is.na(new_dep))) next

    kept <- kept %>%
      mutate(
        arr_sec = new_arr,
        dep_sec = new_dep,
        arrival_time   = sec_to_time(arr_sec),
        departure_time = sec_to_time(dep_sec),
        stop_sequence  = seq_along(keep_idx),
        timepoint = 1
      )

    new_trip_id <- paste0(tpl_trip_id, "_EXP")

    nt <- tr %>%
      mutate(
        route_id = exp_route_id,
        trip_id = new_trip_id,
        trip_headsign = if ("trip_headsign" %in% names(tr)) {
          if_else(
            !is.na(trip_headsign) & nzchar(trip_headsign),
            paste0(trip_headsign, " Express"),
            "Express"
          )
        } else trip_headsign
      )

    nst <- kept %>%
      mutate(trip_id = new_trip_id) %>%
      select(-arr_sec, -dep_sec)

    new_trips[[length(new_trips) + 1]] <- nt
    new_sts[[length(new_sts) + 1]]     <- nst
  }

  list(
    routes_add = exp_route,
    trips_add = bind_rows(new_trips),
    stop_times_add = bind_rows(new_sts)
  )
}

# -----------------------------
# Apply transit signal priority + transit lanes by replacing every trip's
# segment timings with the fastest trip's timings within its
# (route_id, direction_id, pattern_id) group. The trip's first-stop
# departure time is preserved as the anchor.
# -----------------------------
apply_tsp <- function(gtfs) {
  # Recompute pattern_id so express overlays (which inherited the base trip's
  # pattern_id but have a different actual stop sequence) get grouped correctly
  if ("pattern_id" %in% names(gtfs$trips)) {
    gtfs$trips <- gtfs$trips %>% select(-pattern_id)
  }
  gtfs <- add_pattern_id(gtfs)

  st <- gtfs$stop_times %>%
    mutate(
      arr_sec = time_to_sec(arrival_time),
      dep_sec = time_to_sec(departure_time)
    ) %>%
    arrange(trip_id, stop_sequence) %>%
    group_by(trip_id) %>%
    mutate(stop_idx = row_number()) %>%
    ungroup()

  trip_first_dep <- st %>%
    group_by(trip_id) %>%
    summarize(
      first_dep = suppressWarnings(min(dep_sec, na.rm = TRUE)),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    filter(is.finite(first_dep))

  trip_durations <- st %>%
    group_by(trip_id) %>%
    summarize(
      duration = suppressWarnings(max(arr_sec, na.rm = TRUE)) -
                 suppressWarnings(min(dep_sec, na.rm = TRUE)),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    filter(is.finite(duration))

  trip_info <- trip_durations %>%
    inner_join(trip_first_dep, by = "trip_id") %>%
    inner_join(
      gtfs$trips %>% select(trip_id, route_id, direction_id, pattern_id),
      by = "trip_id"
    )

  fastest_trips <- trip_info %>%
    filter(!is.na(pattern_id), duration > 0) %>%
    group_by(route_id, direction_id, pattern_id) %>%
    slice_min(duration, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    select(
      route_id, direction_id, pattern_id,
      fastest_trip_id = trip_id,
      fastest_first_dep = first_dep
    )

  fastest_st_relative <- st %>%
    inner_join(
      fastest_trips %>% select(fastest_trip_id, fastest_first_dep),
      by = c("trip_id" = "fastest_trip_id")
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      rel_arr = arr_sec - fastest_first_dep,
      rel_dep = dep_sec - fastest_first_dep
    ) %>%
    rename(fastest_trip_id = trip_id) %>%
    select(fastest_trip_id, stop_idx, rel_arr, rel_dep)

  trip_to_fastest <- trip_info %>%
    left_join(
      fastest_trips %>% select(route_id, direction_id, pattern_id, fastest_trip_id),
      by = c("route_id", "direction_id", "pattern_id")
    ) %>%
    select(trip_id, first_dep, fastest_trip_id)

  new_st <- st %>%
    left_join(trip_to_fastest, by = "trip_id") %>%
    left_join(fastest_st_relative, by = c("fastest_trip_id", "stop_idx")) %>%
    mutate(
      arrival_time = if_else(
        !is.na(rel_arr) & !is.na(first_dep),
        sec_to_time(first_dep + rel_arr),
        arrival_time
      ),
      departure_time = if_else(
        !is.na(rel_dep) & !is.na(first_dep),
        sec_to_time(first_dep + rel_dep),
        departure_time
      )
    ) %>%
    select(-arr_sec, -dep_sec, -stop_idx, -first_dep, -fastest_trip_id, -rel_arr, -rel_dep)

  gtfs$stop_times <- new_st
  gtfs
}

# -----------------------------
# Total weekly service hours = sum over trips of (last_arr - first_dep)
# weighted by the trip's service_id's days-per-week from calendar.txt.
# Lets us compare networks that share the same calendar structure.
# -----------------------------
compute_service_hours <- function(gtfs, trip_id_filter = NULL) {
  trips <- gtfs$trips
  if (!is.null(trip_id_filter)) {
    trips <- trips %>% filter(trip_id %in% trip_id_filter)
  }

  st <- gtfs$stop_times %>%
    filter(trip_id %in% trips$trip_id) %>%
    mutate(
      arr_sec = time_to_sec(arrival_time),
      dep_sec = time_to_sec(departure_time)
    )

  trip_hours <- st %>%
    group_by(trip_id) %>%
    summarize(
      duration_h = pmax(
        0,
        suppressWarnings(max(arr_sec, na.rm = TRUE)) -
        suppressWarnings(min(dep_sec, na.rm = TRUE))
      ) / 3600,
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    filter(is.finite(duration_h))

  cal <- gtfs$calendar %>%
    mutate(
      days_per_week = as.integer(monday) + as.integer(tuesday) +
                      as.integer(wednesday) + as.integer(thursday) +
                      as.integer(friday) + as.integer(saturday) +
                      as.integer(sunday)
    ) %>%
    select(service_id, days_per_week)

  trips %>%
    select(trip_id, service_id) %>%
    inner_join(trip_hours, by = "trip_id") %>%
    inner_join(cal, by = "service_id") %>%
    mutate(weekly_h = duration_h * days_per_week) %>%
    summarize(total = sum(weekly_h, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
    pull(total)
}

# -----------------------------
# Densify a single (route, direction, pattern) group of trips up to a
# target trip count by inserting clones into existing gaps. Inserts are
# allocated proportional to gap size (largest-remainder method) so the
# longest headways are filled first.
# -----------------------------
densify_to_target <- function(gtfs, group_trips, target_count, id_prefix = "BOOST") {
  group_trips <- group_trips %>% arrange(start_sec)
  N <- nrow(group_trips)

  empty_result <- list(
    trips = gtfs$trips[0, , drop = FALSE],
    stop_times = gtfs$stop_times[0, , drop = FALSE]
  )

  if (N < 2 || target_count <= N) return(empty_result)

  n_to_insert <- as.integer(target_count - N)
  n_gaps <- N - 1L

  gaps <- diff(group_trips$start_sec)
  total_gap <- sum(gaps)
  if (!is.finite(total_gap) || total_gap <= 0) return(empty_result)

  shares <- gaps / total_gap * n_to_insert
  base_per_gap <- as.integer(floor(shares))
  remainder <- as.integer(n_to_insert - sum(base_per_gap))
  fractional <- shares - base_per_gap

  if (remainder > 0L) {
    extra_idx <- order(fractional, decreasing = TRUE)[seq_len(remainder)]
    base_per_gap[extra_idx] <- base_per_gap[extra_idx] + 1L
  }

  st <- gtfs$stop_times %>%
    mutate(
      arr_sec = time_to_sec(arrival_time),
      dep_sec = time_to_sec(departure_time)
    )

  new_trips <- list()
  new_sts <- list()
  ctr <- 0L

  for (i in seq_len(n_gaps)) {
    n_insert_here <- base_per_gap[i]
    if (n_insert_here == 0L) next

    t0 <- group_trips$start_sec[i]
    t1 <- group_trips$start_sec[i + 1]
    dt <- t1 - t0
    if (is.na(dt) || dt <= 0) next

    tpl_trip_id <- group_trips$trip_id[i]
    tpl_trip <- gtfs$trips %>% filter(trip_id == tpl_trip_id)
    tpl_st   <- st %>% filter(trip_id == tpl_trip_id) %>% arrange(stop_sequence)
    if (nrow(tpl_trip) == 0 || nrow(tpl_st) == 0) next

    multiplier_local <- n_insert_here + 1L
    for (k in seq_len(n_insert_here)) {
      ctr <- ctr + 1L
      new_start <- t0 + round(dt * (k / multiplier_local))
      shift <- new_start - t0

      new_trip_id <- paste0(tpl_trip_id, "_", id_prefix, "_", sprintf("%06d", ctr), "_S", shift)

      nt <- tpl_trip %>% mutate(trip_id = new_trip_id)

      nst <- tpl_st %>%
        mutate(
          trip_id = new_trip_id,
          arrival_time   = sec_to_time(arr_sec + shift),
          departure_time = sec_to_time(dep_sec + shift)
        ) %>%
        select(-arr_sec, -dep_sec)

      new_trips[[length(new_trips) + 1]] <- nt
      new_sts[[length(new_sts) + 1]]     <- nst
    }
  }

  list(
    trips = bind_rows(new_trips),
    stop_times = bind_rows(new_sts)
  )
}

# -----------------------------
# Apply per-route slowdown multipliers to stop_times. Scales each
# segment running time by the route's multiplier; dwell times are kept.
# Express overlay routes (whose route_id ends in _EXP) inherit the base
# route's multiplier via suffix-stripping. Trips whose route has no
# multiplier (or multiplier == 1) are passed through unchanged.
# -----------------------------
apply_av_slowdown <- function(gtfs, route_multipliers) {
  trip_to_mult <- gtfs$trips %>%
    select(trip_id, route_id) %>%
    mutate(
      route_id = as.character(route_id),
      lookup_route_id = sub("_EXP$", "", route_id)
    ) %>%
    left_join(
      route_multipliers %>%
        rename(lookup_route_id = route_id),
      by = "lookup_route_id"
    ) %>%
    mutate(multiplier = coalesce(multiplier, 1.0)) %>%
    select(trip_id, multiplier)

  st <- gtfs$stop_times %>%
    arrange(trip_id, stop_sequence) %>%
    mutate(
      arr_sec = time_to_sec(arrival_time),
      dep_sec = time_to_sec(departure_time)
    )

  mult_by_trip <- setNames(trip_to_mult$multiplier,
                           as.character(trip_to_mult$trip_id))

  trip_ids_chr <- as.character(st$trip_id)
  trip_runs <- rle(trip_ids_chr)

  arr <- st$arr_sec
  dep <- st$dep_sec
  affected <- logical(length(arr))

  pb <- progress_bar$new(
    format = "Slowing trips [:bar] :current/:total (:percent) | eta: :eta",
    total = length(trip_runs$values),
    clear = FALSE, width = 60
  )

  start_idx <- 1L
  for (k in seq_along(trip_runs$values)) {
    pb$tick()
    n <- trip_runs$lengths[k]
    end_idx <- start_idx + n - 1L

    if (n >= 2L) {
      tid <- trip_runs$values[k]
      m <- mult_by_trip[[tid]]
      if (!is.null(m) && !is.na(m) && m != 1.0) {
        idx <- start_idx:end_idx
        a_orig <- arr[idx]
        d_orig <- dep[idx]
        a_new  <- a_orig
        d_new  <- d_orig

        for (i in 2:n) {
          if (is.na(a_orig[i]) || is.na(d_orig[i - 1L]) || is.na(d_new[i - 1L])) next

          seg_orig <- a_orig[i] - d_orig[i - 1L]   # ORIGINAL segment running time
          a_new[i] <- d_new[i - 1L] + seg_orig * m # chain on the NEW prev departure

          dwell <- if (!is.na(d_orig[i]) && !is.na(a_orig[i])) {
            max(0, d_orig[i] - a_orig[i])
          } else 0
          d_new[i] <- a_new[i] + dwell
        }

        arr[idx] <- a_new
        dep[idx] <- d_new
        affected[idx] <- TRUE
      }
    }

    start_idx <- end_idx + 1L
  }

  st$arrival_time <- if_else(
    affected & !is.na(arr),
    sec_to_time(round(arr)),
    st$arrival_time
  )
  st$departure_time <- if_else(
    affected & !is.na(dep),
    sec_to_time(round(dep)),
    st$departure_time
  )

  gtfs$stop_times <- st %>% select(-arr_sec, -dep_sec)
  gtfs
}

# -----------------------------
# Thin trips down to a target count by removing evenly-spaced
# intermediate trips. Mirror of densify_to_target: used when buses get
# slower (AV congestion) so that total weekly service hours stay roughly
# constant even though each trip takes longer. First and last trips of
# each (service, route, direction, pattern) group are preserved so the
# operating span is unchanged.
# -----------------------------
thin_eligible_to_factor <- function(gtfs, eligible_patterns, keep_factor) {
  if (!is.finite(keep_factor) || keep_factor >= 1.0) return(gtfs)
  if (keep_factor <= 0) {
    warning("keep_factor <= 0; skipping thinning")
    return(gtfs)
  }

  trips_w_starts <- compute_trip_starts(gtfs)

  thin_groups <- trips_w_starts %>%
    filter(!is.na(start_sec)) %>%
    semi_join(eligible_patterns, by = c("route_id", "direction_id", "pattern_id")) %>%
    group_by(service_id, route_id, direction_id, pattern_id) %>%
    group_split(.keep = TRUE)

  pb <- progress_bar$new(
    format = "Thinning [:bar] :current/:total (:percent) | eta: :eta",
    total = length(thin_groups),
    clear = FALSE, width = 60
  )

  trip_ids_to_drop <- character(0)

  for (grp in thin_groups) {
    pb$tick()
    N <- nrow(grp)
    if (N < 2) next

    target <- max(1L, as.integer(round(N * keep_factor)))
    if (target >= N) next

    grp_sorted <- grp %>% arrange(start_sec)
    keep_idx <- unique(round(seq(1, N, length.out = target)))
    drop_idx <- setdiff(seq_len(N), keep_idx)
    trip_ids_to_drop <- c(trip_ids_to_drop, grp_sorted$trip_id[drop_idx])
  }

  if (length(trip_ids_to_drop) == 0) {
    cat("  No trips removed (group sizes too small to thin meaningfully).\n")
    return(gtfs)
  }

  trip_ids_to_drop <- unique(trip_ids_to_drop)
  cat(sprintf("  Removed %s trips across eligible patterns\n",
              format(length(trip_ids_to_drop), big.mark = ",")))

  gtfs$trips <- gtfs$trips %>%
    filter(!trip_id %in% trip_ids_to_drop)
  gtfs$stop_times <- gtfs$stop_times %>%
    filter(!trip_id %in% trip_ids_to_drop)

  gtfs
}

# -----------------------------
# Prune GTFS tables to referenced entities
# -----------------------------
prune_gtfs <- function(gtfs) {
  # Keep only routes, trips, stop_times already filtered/modified;
  # prune stops/shapes/transfers to match.
  gtfs$routes <- gtfs$routes %>% filter(route_id %in% unique(gtfs$trips$route_id))
  gtfs$shapes <- if ("shapes" %in% names(gtfs) && !is.null(gtfs$shapes)) {
    gtfs$shapes %>% filter(shape_id %in% unique(na.omit(gtfs$trips$shape_id)))
  } else gtfs$shapes

  keep_stops <- unique(gtfs$stop_times$stop_id)
  gtfs$stops <- gtfs$stops %>% filter(stop_id %in% keep_stops)

  if ("transfers" %in% names(gtfs) && !is.null(gtfs$transfers)) {
    gtfs$transfers <- gtfs$transfers %>%
      filter(from_stop_id %in% keep_stops, to_stop_id %in% keep_stops)
  }

  if ("pathways" %in% names(gtfs) && !is.null(gtfs$pathways)) {
    gtfs$pathways <- gtfs$pathways %>%
      filter(from_stop_id %in% keep_stops, to_stop_id %in% keep_stops)
  }

  gtfs
}
```

```{r}
# Build new trips (densify locals) + express overlays
add_trips_all <- list()
add_st_all <- list()

# For express overlays: we collect and add route/trip/stop_time rows
add_routes_exp <- list()
add_trips_exp  <- list()
add_st_exp     <- list()


# Precompute multiplier per route_id for O(1) lookup
mult_by_route <- freq_tbl %>%
  distinct(route_id, multiplier_local) %>%
  mutate(multiplier_local = as.integer(multiplier_local))

# Split trips once by the group key, then iterate over the list
trips_split <- trips_w_starts %>%
  filter(!is.na(start_sec)) %>%
  semi_join(eligible_patterns, by = c("route_id", "direction_id", "pattern_id")) %>%
  group_by(service_id, route_id, direction_id, pattern_id) %>%
  group_split(.keep = TRUE)

pb <- progress_bar$new(
  format = "Densifying [:bar] :current/:total (:percent) | elapsed: :elapsed | eta: :eta",
  total = length(trips_split),
  clear = FALSE,
  width = 60
)

for (grp_trips in trips_split) {
  pb$tick()

  # pull keys from the group's first row
  route_id <- grp_trips$route_id[[1]]

  # multiplier lookup (default 3)
  mult <- mult_by_route$multiplier_local[match(route_id, mult_by_route$route_id)]
  if (is.na(mult)) mult <- 3L

  grp_trips <- grp_trips %>% arrange(start_sec)

  dens <- densify_group(gtfs, grp_trips, multiplier = mult, id_prefix = "DENSE")

  if (nrow(dens$trips) > 0) {
    add_trips_all[[length(add_trips_all) + 1]] <- dens$trips
    add_st_all[[length(add_st_all) + 1]]       <- dens$stop_times
  }
}

# Apply local densification
if (length(add_trips_all) > 0) {
  gtfs$trips <- bind_rows(gtfs$trips, bind_rows(add_trips_all))
  gtfs$stop_times <- bind_rows(gtfs$stop_times, bind_rows(add_st_all))
}
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# Variant 2: Baseline + full TSP (transit lanes + signal priority)
#
# Approximates an end-to-end transit-priority network by replacing every
# trip's segment timings with the fastest existing trip for the same
# (route_id, direction_id, pattern_id) group -- typically a late-night /
# early-morning trip with little traffic. Boardings on slower trips and
# signals encountered by the fast trip are assumed to roughly cancel out.
# ============================================================

cat("\n===== Variant: Baseline + TSP =====\n")

baseline_hours <- compute_service_hours(gtfs_baseline)
cat(sprintf("Baseline weekly service hours:        %s\n",
            format(round(baseline_hours, 1), big.mark = ",")))

gtfs_baseline_tsp <- apply_tsp(gtfs_baseline)

baseline_tsp_hours <- compute_service_hours(gtfs_baseline_tsp)
baseline_savings_pct <- (1 - baseline_tsp_hours / baseline_hours) * 100

cat(sprintf("Baseline + TSP weekly service hours:  %s\n",
            format(round(baseline_tsp_hours, 1), big.mark = ",")))
cat(sprintf("Service-hour savings from TSP:        %.2f%%\n",
            baseline_savings_pct))

gtfs_baseline_tsp <- prune_gtfs(gtfs_baseline_tsp)
out_baseline_tsp <- "./data/gtfs/kcm/kcm_baseline_tsp_april_26.zip"
export_gtfs(gtfs_baseline_tsp, out_baseline_tsp)
cat(sprintf("Saved: %s\n", out_baseline_tsp))
```


```{r}
# ============================================================
# Variant 3: Triplicate + full TSP + frequency boost
#
# Apply TSP to the triplicate, then re-densify the eligible patterns by a
# uniform boost factor so total weekly service hours land back near the
# pre-TSP triplicate. Express overlays (which carry their own _EXP route_id)
# and non-eligible patterns are not boosted, so the boost factor is
# computed against the boostable subset to compensate.
# ============================================================

cat("\n===== Variant: Triplicate + TSP + boost =====\n")

triplicate_hours <- compute_service_hours(gtfs_triplicate)
cat(sprintf("Triplicate weekly service hours:        %s\n",
            format(round(triplicate_hours, 1), big.mark = ",")))

gtfs_triplicate_tsp <- apply_tsp(gtfs_triplicate)

triplicate_tsp_hours <- compute_service_hours(gtfs_triplicate_tsp)
triplicate_savings_pct <- (1 - triplicate_tsp_hours / triplicate_hours) * 100

cat(sprintf("Triplicate + TSP weekly service hours:  %s\n",
            format(round(triplicate_tsp_hours, 1), big.mark = ",")))
cat(sprintf("Service-hour savings from TSP:          %.2f%%\n",
            triplicate_savings_pct))

# Identify trips that fall under the eligible_patterns from the triplicate
# build (these are the only trips the boost will touch). Note: pattern_id was
# recomputed inside apply_tsp(), but for trips inherited unchanged from the
# baseline the recomputed pattern_id matches the original (digest is
# deterministic over the same stop sequence), so the eligible_patterns
# semi_join still resolves correctly.
boost_trip_ids_triple <- gtfs_triplicate$trips %>%
  semi_join(eligible_patterns, by = c("route_id", "direction_id", "pattern_id")) %>%
  pull(trip_id)

boost_trip_ids_tsp <- gtfs_triplicate_tsp$trips %>%
  semi_join(eligible_patterns, by = c("route_id", "direction_id", "pattern_id")) %>%
  pull(trip_id)

boostable_triplicate_h <- compute_service_hours(gtfs_triplicate, boost_trip_ids_triple)
boostable_tsp_h        <- compute_service_hours(gtfs_triplicate_tsp, boost_trip_ids_tsp)
non_boostable_tsp_h    <- triplicate_tsp_hours - boostable_tsp_h

cat(sprintf("\nBoostable subset (eligible patterns, no express overlays):\n"))
cat(sprintf("  Triplicate boostable hours/wk:        %s\n",
            format(round(boostable_triplicate_h, 1), big.mark = ",")))
cat(sprintf("  Triplicate+TSP boostable hours/wk:    %s\n",
            format(round(boostable_tsp_h, 1), big.mark = ",")))
cat(sprintf("  Non-boostable TSP hours/wk (kept):    %s\n",
            format(round(non_boostable_tsp_h, 1), big.mark = ",")))

# Boost factor solves: boost_factor * boostable_tsp_h + non_boostable_tsp_h ~= triplicate_hours
target_boostable_h <- triplicate_hours - non_boostable_tsp_h
boost_factor <- if (boostable_tsp_h > 0) target_boostable_h / boostable_tsp_h else 1.0

cat(sprintf("\nBoost factor applied to eligible patterns: %.4f\n", boost_factor))
cat(sprintf("  -> targeting boostable hours of %s\n",
            format(round(target_boostable_h, 1), big.mark = ",")))

# Apply boost: for each (service, route, direction, pattern) group of the
# eligible patterns, insert clones into the existing gaps to reach a target
# trip count of round(N * boost_factor).
trips_w_starts_tsp <- compute_trip_starts(gtfs_triplicate_tsp)

boost_groups <- trips_w_starts_tsp %>%
  filter(!is.na(start_sec)) %>%
  semi_join(eligible_patterns, by = c("route_id", "direction_id", "pattern_id")) %>%
  group_by(service_id, route_id, direction_id, pattern_id) %>%
  group_split(.keep = TRUE)

add_trips_boost <- list()
add_st_boost    <- list()

pb_boost <- progress_bar$new(
  format = "Boosting [:bar] :current/:total (:percent) | elapsed: :elapsed | eta: :eta",
  total = length(boost_groups),
  clear = FALSE,
  width = 60
)

for (grp_trips in boost_groups) {
  pb_boost$tick()

  N <- nrow(grp_trips)
  target_count <- as.integer(round(N * boost_factor))
  if (target_count <= N) next

  grp_trips <- grp_trips %>% arrange(start_sec)

  boost_res <- densify_to_target(
    gtfs_triplicate_tsp, grp_trips, target_count,
    id_prefix = "BOOST"
  )

  if (nrow(boost_res$trips) > 0) {
    add_trips_boost[[length(add_trips_boost) + 1]] <- boost_res$trips
    add_st_boost[[length(add_st_boost) + 1]]      <- boost_res$stop_times
  }
}

if (length(add_trips_boost) > 0) {
  gtfs_triplicate_tsp$trips <- bind_rows(
    gtfs_triplicate_tsp$trips, bind_rows(add_trips_boost)
  )
  gtfs_triplicate_tsp$stop_times <- bind_rows(
    gtfs_triplicate_tsp$stop_times, bind_rows(add_st_boost)
  )
}

final_hours <- compute_service_hours(gtfs_triplicate_tsp)
cat(sprintf("\nFinal triplicate+TSP+boost weekly hrs: %s (%.1f%% of triplicate)\n",
            format(round(final_hours, 1), big.mark = ","),
            final_hours / triplicate_hours * 100))

gtfs_triplicate_tsp <- prune_gtfs(gtfs_triplicate_tsp)
out_triplicate_tsp <- "./data/gtfs/kcm/kcm_triplicate_tsp_april_26.zip"
export_gtfs(gtfs_triplicate_tsp, out_triplicate_tsp)
cat(sprintf("Saved: %s\n", out_triplicate_tsp))
```

```{r av-variants}
# ============================================================
# Variants 4 & 5: Baseline + AV congestion / Triplicate + AV congestion
#
# Each KCM route is slowed by a per-route multiplier read from
# data/own/kcm_av_route_slowdown.csv. The multipliers were generated once,
# with a preliminary road-congestion model of AV-induced traffic: for each
# route, the length-weighted mean of (congested / free-flow link time) over the
# road links within 30 ft of the route's most-served shape. Each trip's segment
# running times (arrival[i] - departure[i-1]) are scaled by the multiplier;
# dwell times are kept. Routes with no multiplier are left unchanged.
#
# Express overlay routes (route_id ending in _EXP) inherit the multiplier
# of their base route via suffix-stripping inside apply_av_slowdown().
# ============================================================

cat("\n===== Variants: Baseline + AV / Triplicate + AV =====\n")

av_multipliers <- readr::read_csv("./data/own/kcm_av_route_slowdown.csv",
                                  col_types = "cd", show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  rename(multiplier = av_slowdown_multiplier)

cat("\nRoute-level AV slowdown multiplier:\n")
print(summary(av_multipliers$multiplier))

# Helper closure: given a "before" GTFS (target hours), an "after-AV-slowdown"
# GTFS, the target total weekly hours, and eligible_patterns, compute the
# keep_factor that brings the eligible-pattern subset back down so total
# hours land near `target_hours`. Mirrors the boost-factor logic from the
# TSP+boost chunk: non-eligible patterns are slowed but not thinned, so
# the eligible subset has to absorb the full compensation.
compute_keep_factor <- function(gtfs_before, gtfs_av, target_hours,
                                total_av_hours, eligible_patterns) {
  elig_trip_ids_av <- gtfs_av$trips %>%
    semi_join(eligible_patterns, by = c("route_id", "direction_id", "pattern_id")) %>%
    pull(trip_id)
  elig_trip_ids_before <- gtfs_before$trips %>%
    semi_join(eligible_patterns, by = c("route_id", "direction_id", "pattern_id")) %>%
    pull(trip_id)

  elig_av_h     <- compute_service_hours(gtfs_av,     elig_trip_ids_av)
  elig_before_h <- compute_service_hours(gtfs_before, elig_trip_ids_before)
  non_elig_av_h <- total_av_hours - elig_av_h

  target_elig_h <- target_hours - non_elig_av_h
  keep_factor   <- if (elig_av_h > 0) target_elig_h / elig_av_h else 1.0

  list(
    elig_before_h = elig_before_h,
    elig_av_h     = elig_av_h,
    non_elig_av_h = non_elig_av_h,
    target_elig_h = target_elig_h,
    keep_factor   = keep_factor
  )
}

# --- Baseline + AV ---
cat("\n--- Applying AV slowdown to baseline ---\n")
gtfs_baseline_av <- apply_av_slowdown(gtfs_baseline, av_multipliers)

baseline_av_hours_pre <- compute_service_hours(gtfs_baseline_av)
cat(sprintf("Baseline + AV weekly service hours (pre-thin):   %s (%+.2f%% vs baseline)\n",
            format(round(baseline_av_hours_pre, 1), big.mark = ","),
            (baseline_av_hours_pre / baseline_hours - 1) * 100))

# Hold service hours constant by removing trips on eligible patterns
kf_baseline <- compute_keep_factor(
  gtfs_before    = gtfs_baseline,
  gtfs_av        = gtfs_baseline_av,
  target_hours   = baseline_hours,
  total_av_hours = baseline_av_hours_pre,
  eligible_patterns = eligible_patterns
)

cat(sprintf("\nBoostable subset (eligible patterns):\n"))
cat(sprintf("  Baseline eligible hours/wk:           %s\n",
            format(round(kf_baseline$elig_before_h, 1), big.mark = ",")))
cat(sprintf("  Baseline+AV eligible hours/wk:        %s\n",
            format(round(kf_baseline$elig_av_h, 1), big.mark = ",")))
cat(sprintf("  Non-eligible AV hours/wk (kept):      %s\n",
            format(round(kf_baseline$non_elig_av_h, 1), big.mark = ",")))
cat(sprintf("\nKeep factor applied to eligible patterns: %.4f\n",
            kf_baseline$keep_factor))
cat(sprintf("  -> targeting eligible hours of %s\n",
            format(round(kf_baseline$target_elig_h, 1), big.mark = ",")))

gtfs_baseline_av <- thin_eligible_to_factor(
  gtfs_baseline_av, eligible_patterns, kf_baseline$keep_factor
)

baseline_av_hours <- compute_service_hours(gtfs_baseline_av)
cat(sprintf("\nFinal baseline+AV weekly hrs: %s (%.1f%% of baseline)\n",
            format(round(baseline_av_hours, 1), big.mark = ","),
            baseline_av_hours / baseline_hours * 100))

gtfs_baseline_av <- prune_gtfs(gtfs_baseline_av)
out_baseline_av <- "./data/gtfs/kcm/kcm_baseline_av_april_26.zip"
export_gtfs(gtfs_baseline_av, out_baseline_av)
cat(sprintf("Saved: %s\n", out_baseline_av))

# --- Triplicate + AV ---
cat("\n--- Applying AV slowdown to triplicate ---\n")
gtfs_triplicate_av <- apply_av_slowdown(gtfs_triplicate, av_multipliers)

triplicate_av_hours_pre <- compute_service_hours(gtfs_triplicate_av)
cat(sprintf("Triplicate + AV weekly service hours (pre-thin): %s (%+.2f%% vs triplicate)\n",
            format(round(triplicate_av_hours_pre, 1), big.mark = ","),
            (triplicate_av_hours_pre / triplicate_hours - 1) * 100))

kf_triplicate <- compute_keep_factor(
  gtfs_before    = gtfs_triplicate,
  gtfs_av        = gtfs_triplicate_av,
  target_hours   = triplicate_hours,
  total_av_hours = triplicate_av_hours_pre,
  eligible_patterns = eligible_patterns
)

cat(sprintf("\nBoostable subset (eligible patterns):\n"))
cat(sprintf("  Triplicate eligible hours/wk:         %s\n",
            format(round(kf_triplicate$elig_before_h, 1), big.mark = ",")))
cat(sprintf("  Triplicate+AV eligible hours/wk:      %s\n",
            format(round(kf_triplicate$elig_av_h, 1), big.mark = ",")))
cat(sprintf("  Non-eligible AV hours/wk (kept):      %s\n",
            format(round(kf_triplicate$non_elig_av_h, 1), big.mark = ",")))
cat(sprintf("\nKeep factor applied to eligible patterns: %.4f\n",
            kf_triplicate$keep_factor))
cat(sprintf("  -> targeting eligible hours of %s\n",
            format(round(kf_triplicate$target_elig_h, 1), big.mark = ",")))

gtfs_triplicate_av <- thin_eligible_to_factor(
  gtfs_triplicate_av, eligible_patterns, kf_triplicate$keep_factor
)

triplicate_av_hours <- compute_service_hours(gtfs_triplicate_av)
cat(sprintf("\nFinal triplicate+AV weekly hrs: %s (%.1f%% of triplicate)\n",
            format(round(triplicate_av_hours, 1), big.mark = ","),
            triplicate_av_hours / triplicate_hours * 100))

gtfs_triplicate_av <- prune_gtfs(gtfs_triplicate_av)
out_triplicate_av <- "./data/gtfs/kcm/kcm_triplicate_av_april_26.zip"
export_gtfs(gtfs_triplicate_av, out_triplicate_av)
cat(sprintf("Saved: %s\n", out_triplicate_av))
```
